name: Cyrene
notes: DRAFT. Source: Fribbels Cyrene scoring.simulation(). SPD: target 180 (a kit threshold and a Fribbels hard breakpoint, Cyrene.ts:478-480; benchmarks.md:147 scores a miss as 0%), reached by 18 distributed SPD rolls under K14e's relaxed cap (see spd_target and distributed.notes). Fribbels file: vendor/hsr-optimizer/src/lib/conditionals/character/1400/Cyrene.ts. Fribbels line numbers in Cyrene.ts: simulation 451-505, parts 453-470, substats 471-477. Facts about set effects and kits come from tools/gamedata/lc-text.mjs --set <id> and kit-text.mjs output. Written 2026-11-13 as a draft for Smitty to review; every GUESS is a choice Fribbels does not make.

relic_sets.notes: First-listed relic set (Cyrene.ts:491): World-Remaking Deliverer 4-piece (needs her memosprite on the field). The 2-piece gives +8% CRIT Rate.

ornament_set.name: Bone Collection's Serene Demesne
ornament_set.notes: First-listed ornament (Cyrene.ts:496): Bone Collection's Serene Demesne (+12% Max HP; +28% CRIT DMG at 5000 Max HP or more, wearer and memosprite). Amphoreus (+8% SPD to allies with a memosprite) is also in Fribbels' list and would add 8% of base (about 8); not used because Bone Collection is first-listed.

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG/HP%, Feet HP%/SPD, Sphere HP%/Ice DMG, Rope HP%. Feet SPD because of the 180 target. GUESS: Body CRIT Rate (proxy +4.5% over HP% body, +4.7% over CRIT DMG body). Sphere Ice DMG (proxy +14.7% over HP%). Rope HP% only.

spd_target.reason: Kit threshold and Fribbels hard breakpoint, both 180: her trace Causality in Trichotomy gives all allies +20% DMG at 180 SPD or more and Ice RES PEN per excess SPD up to 60 (kit-text.mjs 1415), and Cyrene.ts:478-480 sets hardBreakpoints SPD 180 (benchmarks.md:147: missing a SPD breakpoint scores 0%). Smitty's Cyrene shows 192 out of combat (2026-11-13), so the target is reachable. The Ice RES PEN above 180 is a bonus, not a threshold.

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, HP%, HP, SPD. SPD: target 180 (K14e). 101 base + 9 (traces) + 25.032 + 4.6 = 139.632; 17 rolls make 178.732 (short), 18 make 181.032 (margin 1.032). The KQMS cap for SPD with SPD boots is 10, so K14e lets SPD pass it by 8 rolls; total SPD rolls 20, under the physical limit of 30. Smitty's account shows 192 out of combat, so 181 is below what his relics reach. The earlier draft stopped at the cap (10 rolls, 162.632) and had CRIT DMG 5 and CRIT Rate 9; 8 of those 14 rolls are cut. GUESS: CRIT Rate 3 and CRIT DMG 3, from a marginal check on the 6 spare rolls (CRIT Rate 5 + 8 (2-piece) + 32.4 (body) + 5.832 (2 fixed rolls) = 51.2%; CRIT DMG 50 + 37.3 (traces) + 11.664 (2 fixed rolls) = 99.0%; a CRIT DMG roll adds 5.832 x 51.2% to the crit multiplier, a CRIT Rate roll 2.916 x 99.0%, so they balance near CRIT DMG = 2 x CRIT Rate; 3 + 3 has the best CRIT Rate x CRIT DMG product of the 6-roll splits, Computed in the scratch script). HP% was NOT tested here: her basic ATK is 50% of Max HP, so HP% rolls may beat crit for her; Smitty should say. Priority: file counts (CRIT DMG 3 and CRIT Rate 3 tie, Fribbels' list order puts CRIT DMG first), then HP% and HP (0 rolls). SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs.
